today.theme: Talk about cycling as everyday transport
today.source: BBC Learning English — 6 Minute English: Should we cycle more?
today.listen_task: First pass: note why cycling is common in the Netherlands and what Gulf cities hope cycling will improve. With the transcript, catch how speakers describe habits that are ‘deeply ingrained’ vs trends that ‘take off’.
today.speaking_task: In 30 seconds, say how often you cycle (or would cycle) in the Netherlands, one benefit for quality of life, and one reason it is hard for some people to start.

phrases.phrase: It's deeply ingrained in the culture.
phrases.note: Say a habit is firmly established and unlikely to change.

phrases.phrase: Sales really took off last year.
phrases.note: Describe something suddenly becoming popular or successful.

phrases.phrase: It improves quality of life / liveability.
phrases.note: Talk about comfort, health, and how pleasant a place is to live in.
